sources.quote: HD 98219, also named Hunahpú, is a subgiant star in the constellation Crater.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.9 solar radii and 1.38 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,979 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
